answer: A fake identity only pays while it is free and instantly usable. Make every new identity post a bond into a shared vault, then wait through a probation window with no voting power while it completes small, publicly auditable jobs. Established peers with no shared history must endorse its record, each endorsement staked on the voucher's own standing. If it cheats, the bond is slashed and the record cut, like an opal cracking under strain. One operator can print a thousand names in a meadow of empty claims, but it cannot print a thousand independent, staked, time-tested histories.
